PDF Using Ray Intersection for Dual Isosurfacing
We present a dual isosurfacing method based on ray intersection to determine isosurface points (Co et al., 2003) (Parker et al., 1998). Since we are using a dual approach, our algorithm has the typical advantages of being able to extract sharp features, generating nice triagulations, and being extendable to isosurface gen-eration from adaptively re ned grids without gener-ating discontinuities ...
